current.text: Klay Thompson signed with Miami this offseason. Miami traded away Jaime Jaquez Jr. in the same period.
Miami has the fewest back-to-backs in the league (13) and none in the fantasy playoffs. It plays only 10 games in the fantasy playoff weeks.

durable.text: Threes are his only category clearly above the pool. Steals are a league-level weakness, and his FG% and rebounds are also well below the pool.

tags.name: bad playoff schedule
tags.detail: Only 10 Miami games in the fantasy playoff weeks, though no back-to-backs

note: Klay Thompson is not worth drafting in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 207 at a 1 USD cost, ESPN ranks him 224, and both value him at 0. Apart from about 2.6 threes a game, he hurts you in steals, FG% (around 40%) and rebounds. Treat him as a waiver option for teams that need threes, and check early on whether he gets more than about 22 minutes in Miami's thin backcourt.
